title: mudev plugin definition
description: A Moodle plugin catalogue entry: public, generic, stable facts about a plugin. Used standalone in mdl-plugins/<vendor>/<package>.yaml and inline inside recipes. Kept intentionally open (additionalProperties) so a future catalogue website can add presentation metadata without breaking mudev.

name.description: Composer-style vendor/package identifier and the map key everywhere — the clean bare frankenstyle form (no 'moodle-' prefix). The actual registered Packagist/composer package name may differ (Moodle's plugin guidelines prefix it with 'moodle-') and is recorded in the `composer` field, not here.

title.description: Human display name for a catalogue UI (e.g. "Programs", not the meaningless slug `tool_muprog`). The canonical English fallback — composer has no title field, so this is a mudev/catalogue extension. Localized names are NOT stored here; a catalogue site reads them from the plugin's own lang packs (lang/<xx>/<component>.php `$string['pluginname']`) and falls back to this.

description.description: Short one-line human summary (the composer `description`). Long-form copy is the repo README (Packagist convention), not stored here.

relpath.description: Explicit install path relative to the Moodle code root, in the newest (public/) layout. Never derived from the frankenstyle name. A recipe's moodle.strippublic strips the public/ prefix for older Moodle branches (pre-5.1).

source.description: Acquisition methods for the code, as a map of one-or-more source kinds that can COEXIST — each consumer picks the kind it supports (mudev reads `git`; a composer-based assembler reads `composer`; a plain installer would read `zip`). The kind is the KEY (no `type` discriminator), so one entry can advertise several ways to get the same plugin at once. Optional overall (a catalogue may advertise a plugin with no clone source; mudev errors only when an install needs git). The catalogue defines `git` and `composer` today; `zip` is a reserved sibling.

git.description: Git acquisition: named remotes plus (in a recipe) the ref to check out.

remotes.description: Git remotes as name → URL string. `origin` is the primary clone remote; `upstream` (forks) and `backup` (mirror) are optional.

ref.description: Version selector — normally absent in the public catalogue (resolved per recipe). git's `<remote>/<branch>` for a branch, or a tag/commit.

composer.description: Composer acquisition: the Packagist package name. Presence = the plugin is published on Packagist (commonly Moodle's `moodle-`prefixed form, which differs from the frankenstyle `name`); absence = not on Packagist. The version constraint is not stored here — a composer-based assembler derives it from the recipe's release version.

contributed_by.description: Attribution party for this catalogue entry under CC BY 4.0. Reusers must retain it (see the catalogue README). A name or list of names.

requirements.description: Per-git-branch support and dependencies — merges the old `supported` (Moodle compatibility) and `require` (plugin deps) into one branch-keyed block, because both are properties of a branch, not of the plugin globally. Keyed by the git branch that serves a set of Moodle versions (`MOODLE_500_STABLE` → mdlbranches 500/501/502); keys are branch names (safe strings), while the numeric `mdlbranch` codes stay VALUES inside `mdlbranches`, never object keys (numeric object keys get reordered by JS and coerced to ints by PHP — unsafe cross-language). mudev inverts this to an mdlbranch→branch lookup at load (erroring on a duplicate mdlbranch across branches) to resolve a bare reference at a recipe's mdlbranch; the pick is advisory (Moodle validates at install; a recipe that pins source.git.ref bypasses it). Named `requirements` after Moodle's version.php `$plugin->requires`/dependencies.

additionalProperties.description: What this git branch needs: the Moodle branches it serves, and the plugins it depends on.

mdlbranches.description: Moodle $branch codes (as strings) that this git branch serves. mudev checks the branch out for a bare reference at any of these codes.

plugins.description: Plugin identifiers this branch depends on (resolved via catalog at the same mdlbranch — no version constraint needed, the branch context supplies it). Omit when there are no dependencies.
